thread:
Noah (PM): Quick alignment: we need a thin, launchable observability surface for Console next sprint. Goal = surface cost, error fingerprints, and trace links with minimal infra impact.
Tara (Eng): Proposal: scope the "obs-lite" feature. Deliverables: 1) cost heatmap by model+route, 2) error fingerprint list with sample traces, 3) sampling header + opt-in flag.
Diego (Observability): For error fingerprints, return a short fingerprint key (hash of error type + route) and show top 20 per day. That avoids storing full traces for everything.
Priya (Data): Cost heatmap should use daily bucket, show percent cached vs new, and allow CSV S3 export with masked customer_ids.
Alex (SRE): Must have: no extra tail latency >2ms p95, feature behind flag per-deployment, and rollout plan for quota.
Noah (PM): Draft acceptance criteria:
- Cost heatmap shows model/route/day with cache% and total cost.
- Error table lists fingerprint, count, top-3 trace IDs (if sampled).
- Tracing header key X-Rw-Trace allowed; server can generate if missing.
- Sample rate configurable; default 1%.
- Exports to S3 (CSV) for billing/pilots.
Tara (Eng): Implementation sketch: add header passthrough, emit metric labels (trace_fingerprint), small sidecar job to write CSV to S3 nightly. I'll keep metric cardinality low.
Diego (Observability): UI notes: heatmap cell click -> expands route detail -> shows top fingerprints and "open trace" links. Simple drilldown only.
Priya (Data): Retention policy suggestion: full sampled traces 14 days, fingerprint counts 180 days, billing exports indefinitely in customer S3. Masked IDs in product console (redact last 4 chars).
Alex (SRE): Canary plan: enable obs-lite on internal staging, then 10% of internal tenants, then 2 pilot customers. Monitor token throughput, error-rate delta, and ingestion QPS.
Noah (PM): Prioritization (MUST vs SHOULD):
MUST: heatmap (model+route), error fingerprint table, trace header + sampling, CSV export, rollout flag.
SHOULD: per-customer spend drilldown in UI, auto alert suggestions, heatmap weekly aggregation.
Tara (Eng): Quick config example for sampling and export:
```
observability:
  obs_lite: true
  sampling:
    header: X-Rw-Trace
    default_rate: 0.01
  export:
    s3_bucket: "redwood-billing-exports"
    mask_customer_id: true
```
Priya (Data): SQL snippet for daily cost aggregation:
```
SELECT day, model, route, SUM(tokens) AS tokens, SUM(cost) AS cost, SUM(is_cached::int) AS cached_hits
FROM inference_events
WHERE day >= '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY day, model, route
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
Diego (Observability): Fingerprint algorithm: short stable hash of (error_class + route + normalized_msg). We'll store counts and a few sampled trace_ids per fingerprint.
Alex (SRE): Performance note: make sampling decision before heavy CPU work. Keep tracing code in hot path minimal.
Tara (Eng): Timeline proposal: Day0-2 design + infra task, Day3-6 implement header+sampling+metric label, Day7-10 pipeline + CSV export, Day11-14 UI + canary.
Noah (PM): Launch go/no-go criteria: all MUST items implemented, perf tests show <2ms p95 overhead, canary stable for 72h on pilots, export validated.
Priya (Data): Privacy callout: we'll store masked customer identifiers in Console; full identifiers only in customer S3 export with encryption. Need to add to compliance checklist.
Diego (Observability): I'll prepare figma mockups for heatmap and error table, plus a tiny acceptance test: clicking "open trace" must open sampled trace in trace viewer.
Tara (Eng): I'll open PRs for sampling and CSV job, tag @Diego @Alex for review.
ci-bot: Deployment pipeline triggered for branch obs-lite/sampling (build passed).
Noah (PM): Assigning action items: Tara = impl + PR, Diego = mocks + acceptance tests, Priya = export schema + retention, Alex = canary checklist. Review Wed standup.
Tara (Eng): One quick question: do we include quantization guidance in this doc? I think skip; add a note linking to Optimize later.
Noah (PM): Agreed. Add a short line in decision doc: "see Redwood Optimize for per-model quantization tradeoffs".
Alex (SRE): No blockers from infra at this time.
Priya (Data): Preparing a sample masked CSV for pilots.
Diego (Observability): Starting mocks now.
Noah (PM): Great. Ping me if anything blocks. Thanks everyone :rocket:
